reason: I won't pay premium prices for green chutney that likely relies on heavy vinegar and artificial greens to survive room-temperature courier transit.
objection: ₹99 for 100g feels steep when a 200g pouch of Mother's Recipe is ₹70 and 500g Maggi is ₹72, plus I suspect heavy preservatives.
would_change_my_mind: A clean-label guarantee showing real lime juice, no synthetic acetic acid (INS 260), and no artificial green coloring.
